designDecisions: COMBINED INCREMENT (Max 2026-07-21 'go!'): audit Inc-3 spine + depth-law rider are one build — same vertical-honesty seam family. The math check convicted both together: the finding 'craters resolve when g/R turned up' fingerprints reliefNorm (stamp count is scale-free ~147; only reliefNorm moves with g/R), and the molten read needs BOTH the 7x over-drive removed AND the hemispherical pits fixed.

ENVELOPE IS DERIVED, NOT CLAMPED: the relief bound comes from a strength-limited h_max/R law sized against real-body anchors (Earth-class ~0.003-0.01, Moon-class ~0.01-0.05, Mimas-class ~0.05-0.15, absolute ceiling ~0.40 Phobos) — no hand-tuned aesthetic clamp. The g^-0.5 SIGN is correct and kept (lower g => proportionally higher relief); the defect is magnitude + the uncapped 1/RE term. Small bodies SHOULD read lumpy — do not flatten toward Earth-smooth.

DOUBLE-DIP RESOLUTION (audit footnote 14): post-v2-6, g derives from drawn R, so g-based factors already carry radius signal. ALL radius/gravity exponents across height-bearing families are sized together in ONE derivation note in BUILD-PLAN; no family may compound explicit rF and g-derived factors blindly.

DEPTH LAW: fresh simple craters d/D = 0.20 constant; complex rolloff above transition diameter D_t proportional to 1/g (anchors: Earth ~3.5 km, Mercury ~10 km, Moon ~18 km — most craters on low-g bodies stay simple bowls); the shipped delta^-0.5 inversion (d/D rising to ~1.09 at the small end) is the convicted defect. Depth edits must NOT move count, placement, or areal coverage — the SFD and stamping are untouched.
RENDER-SIDE ONLY for the spine: composite/bake-seam multiplier; carrier bytes untouched; craterField churn legitimate ONLY in the depth/profile dimension.

PLAN MUST GROUND-TRUTH THE SEAM FIRST (v2-4 lesson): the audit assumed the spine did not exist; the math check found a live reliefNorm at the lab-core/lab.html sites. BUILD-PLAN states what EXISTS vs what changes before any edit is specced.
Unit-sphere ruling stands (audit section 2): R=1.0 mesh, camera in radii; radius is expressed through feature scale (and later the limb cue), never mesh scaling.
